mapper.sql: n.notice_id AS id, n.title, n.content, n.member_id AS author_user_id, n.author_name, n.views AS view_count, DATE_FORMAT(n.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS created_at, DATE_FORMAT(n.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM notice n
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notice_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice ( title, content, member_id, author_name ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{authorUserId}, COALESCE(#{authorName}, #{authorUserId}) )
